output_evals.prompt: Przetestuj trend template na GPW od 2019 z kapitałem 50 tys. zł w mBanku na zwykłym rachunku.
assertions: scripts/gpw_backtester.py run --strategy trend_template was executed with --broker mbank --capital 50000 --account regular
The answer in Polish starts with the verdict (robustness.verdict) and lists its reasons
The cost drag and the tax drag are stated next to the net CAGR
Net CAGR and max drawdown are compared with WIG and with the equal-weight universe
The answer says this is a historical test, not a forecast, and never promises a return
If metrics.concentration shows that the top trades made most of the profit, this is mentioned
No instruction to buy or sell any stock

output_evals.prompt: Is momentum rotation on WSE overfitted? Run a walk-forward.
assertions: scripts/gpw_backtester.py walkforward (or grid) --strategy momentum_rotation was executed
The answer reports the OOS/IS Sharpe ratio, PBO and the Deflated Sharpe with the number of trials, explained in plain words
The answer reports the plateau result and the 2x cost stress
The answer mentions the Zaremba & Konieczka finding that WSE premiums shrink after costs, or the cost drag from the report

output_evals.prompt: Sprawdź strategię: kupuję, gdy kurs jest nad SMA200, a RSI(14) spada poniżej 35; sprzedaję, gdy RSI > 60 albo po 30 sesjach; stop 2,5 ATR.
assertions: A rules JSON with entry (close > sma 200 and rsi 14 < 35), exit (rsi > 60), max_hold 30 and stop atr_mult 2.5 was written and shown to the user
If the script exits 1 with a rule error, the error is reported and the JSON fixed, no numbers invented

output_evals.prompt: Backtest DCA w WIG po 1000 zł miesięcznie.
assertions: scripts/gpw_backtester.py run --strategy dca_buy_hold --param monthly=1000 was executed
